description: 2019 is the Year of the Earth Pig in the Chinese zodiac, from February 5, 2019 to January 24, 2020. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 2019 is the Year of the Earth Pig, a Yin year. It began at Lunar New Year on February 5, 2019 and ended on January 24, 2020, so people born in 2019 before Feb 5 belong to the Earth Dog year.

sections.heading: 2019 Lunar New Year: start and end dates
paragraphs: Lunar New Year opened the Earth Pig year on February 5, 2019, and the year ran to January 24, 2020. So a birth date of Feb 5, 2019 or later counts as Earth Pig, and so do early 2020 birthdays through Jan 24; births in 2019 before Feb 5 still belong to the Earth Dog. That moving boundary comes from the lunisolar calendar, in which the new year starts with the second new moon after the winter solstice in most years, so its Gregorian date shifts by up to a month from one year to the next. Look sixty years either side and the pairing repeats: 1959 are Earth Pig years too. That Tuesday new year arrived with the Sun in Aquarius in the Western zodiac.

sections.heading: What the Earth Pig is like
paragraphs: A full table and a well-kept house are the traditional emblems of this year. Because Earth controls Water, readings describe a Pig whose generosity is grounded and dependable. Those born now often shine in hospitality and practical care. Accepting help in return, and mindful habits around comfort, keep their contentment from turning into confinement. Family gatherings often revolve around their kitchen and their patient, good-humoured care.

In classical thought, Earth belongs to the centre and to the late-summer pause between seasons, the point where things ripen and settle. As a year stem, it tends to slow an animal down in a useful way, adding prudence, loyalty and a strong sense of responsibility. People born under an Earth stem are often described as dependable, sensible and protective of the people they love. They value security and tend to build carefully. The caution traditionally attached to Earth is caution itself: overthinking, clinging to the familiar and carrying other people's problems as though they were their own.

sections.heading: 2019 in the animal cycle and in numerology
paragraphs: In numerology the digits of this year reduce to 3, associated with expression, creativity and sociability, so a 3 year is described as lively and communicative. The digits of 2019 add up to 12, which reduces to 3. The Pig holds the twelfth place among the twelve animals and its fixed element is Water. Set beside the year's Earth stem, earth controls Water, which readings use to describe how settled or stretched the combination feels. The year before was the Earth Dog and the year after is the Metal Rat.

Chinese almanacs name 2019 Ji-Hai, pairing the Earth stem Ji with the branch Hai. Both are Yin, as stem and branch always share a polarity, so of the hundred and twenty possible pairings only sixty ever occur, and each one names a single year in every cycle.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 2019?
faq.answer: 2019 is the Year of the Earth Pig. It started on February 5, 2019 and ended on January 24, 2020.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 2019?
faq.answer: Check the date against Feb 5. Born before February 5, 2019, you are a Earth Dog; born on or after it, you are a Earth Pig.

faq.question: What element is 2019 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Earth, a Yin year. The Pig's own fixed element is Water; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 2019?
faq.answer: Ji-Hai. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Earth Pig year?
faq.answer: 2079, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 1959.
